app_info.subtitle: Image, video & audio in chat
app_info.description: Browse the live Atlas Cloud model catalog and run image, video, audio and transcription jobs straight from chat. You sign in once in the browser with your Atlas account, so there is no API key to copy or paste and generation is billed to your own balance. Small jobs run straight away; an expensive job returns a quote and waits for your explicit confirmation before anything is charged. Also bundles the Atlas Cloud API integration guide and prompt-craft skills for building Atlas into your own project.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the bounded Atlas model catalog and documentation without changing account or public state. It performs no writes to the user's Atlas account, tasks, or assets.
justifications.open_world_justification: Bounded to the Atlas Cloud catalog and the authenticated account; it does not reach any system outside Atlas Cloud.
justifications.destructive_justification: Alters no state; repeated calls return the same information at no charge.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a billable external generation task and asset; a stable idempotency key prevents duplicate effects. It is not read-only: it submits a billable job to the user's Atlas account and stores its output there.
justifications.open_world_justification: Calls the Atlas Cloud generation API, which dispatches to third-party model providers and stores output on external object storage; results are not bounded to a closed dataset.
justifications.destructive_justification: Spends the user's own Atlas balance, which cannot be un-spent. Every request is priced against the live catalog before anything is submitted. A quote under the auto-submit limit (MCP_AUTOSUBMIT_MAX_USD, USD 20 by default) is submitted directly and the result reports the amount actually charged; a quote at or above the limit, or one the platform will not price firmly, returns the quote plus an opaque confirmation token and spends nothing until the user explicitly confirms in a later turn. The gate fails closed: a quote that cannot be obtained, or that the platform marks partial, also requires confirmation. A stable idempotency key deduplicates retries so a network retry cannot bill twice.

test_cases.description: Connection and authorization smoke test. A read-only catalog call confirms the OAuth sign-in completed and the MCP session is live. No charge.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the image generation models available on Atlas Cloud
test_cases.expected_output: A list of image models with model IDs and capability labels. $0 charged.

test_cases.description: Model detail lookup. Returns the full input schema, enums, defaults and pricing for one model. No charge.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the parameters and pricing for bytedance/seedream-v5.0-lite
test_cases.expected_output: Input schema with enum values and defaults, plus per-generation pricing. $0 charged.

test_cases.description: Low-cost generation under the spend limit submits directly without a confirmation round-trip, reports the actual charge, and saves the image locally so it renders inline.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use seedream to generate a 512x512 image of an orange cat sitting on a windowsill
test_cases.expected_output: No confirmation prompt, because the quote of USD 0.0315 is far under the USD 20 auto-submit limit. The image is shown in the conversation and the actual charge is stated.

test_cases.description: Billing attribution. The balance returned belongs to the signed-in user's own Atlas account, demonstrating per-user billing rather than a shared service account. No charge.
test_cases.expected_output: The authenticated user's own balance. $0 charged.

test_cases.description: Asynchronous result retrieval using the prediction ID from the previous generation. No charge.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use atlas_get_prediction to check the result of the task you just submitted
test_cases.expected_output: status: completed with the output URL. $0 charged.

negative_test_cases.description: Unknown model ID is rejected before submission. The ID is validated against the live catalog; nothing is submitted and nothing is charged.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: A clear 'model not found' error. No prediction ID, $0 charged.

negative_test_cases.description: Missing required parameter fails schema validation before submission; the error names the missing field. Nothing is charged.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Generate an image with seedream but do not give it any prompt
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Validation error naming the missing required field. No prediction ID, $0 charged.

negative_test_cases.description: Generation at or above the auto-submit limit (USD 20) stops at a quote. The server prices the request against the live catalog, returns the price plus a confirmation token, and charges nothing; only an explicit user confirmation in a later turn may submit. The model cannot bypass this, and words like continue or retry are not treated as consent. The model and parameters are spelled out on purpose so the quote is deterministic rather than left to the model's choice of resolution.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use bytedance/seedance-2.5/text-to-video with resolution 4k-esr and duration 25 to generate a video of ocean waves at sunset
negative_test_cases.expected_output: A quote of roughly USD 42.59 (above the USD 20 limit) plus a confirmation_token, and no prediction ID. $0 is charged unless the reviewer explicitly confirms in a following message.

source_snapshot.note: Tool count is the remote (production) profile. The stdio profile additionally registers atlas_chat and atlas_upload_media, which are not exposed at the production URL; main branch is 1.7.0 and describes a different service.
